name: isotox-v5-5_12
comment: VALENCE-STRATIFIED k=3 RUN (AL, 2026-09-01). Same tiles as isotox-sub-5_12, vertex valence capped at 5. COMPLETE for every solid all of whose vertices are valence <= 5, and that is not a small stratum: of the 640 vertices in the 14 solids this shelf ships, 490 are valence 3, 120 valence 4, 10 valence 5 and only 20 are valence 6 — all twenty inside one solid, iso-80-150-72. The cap is what makes k=3 affordable: measured on one shard of 200, valence 6 costs 3,782,076,670 nodes and ~10 GB against 9,509,261 and 56 MB here, ~400x. The valence-6 stratum is a separate, much larger run and is NOT covered by this one.
